back: Link back to the Plugins page's Installed tab.
loading: Accessible name of the placeholder shown while the plugin's page loads.
load-failed: Error toast when the plugin's page could not load.
report: Button that files an issue about this plugin on the Improvements board.
missing.title: Page title when no plugin with the address's id is installed.
overview.title: Heading of the plugin's first section: what it is and whether it runs.
overview.enabled: Label of the switch that turns the plugin on or off.
overview.off-bundled: Under that label, for a plugin that runs inside Socio: what turning it off does.
overview.off-service: Under that label, for a plugin that runs as its own service: what turning it off does (scales to zero: no copy of it runs).
overview.enable: Accessible name of the switch while the plugin is off. {{name}} is the plugin's name.
overview.disable: Accessible name of the switch while the plugin is on. {{name}} is the plugin's name.
access.title: Heading of the section that chooses who can use the plugin.
access.audience: Label of the list: admins only, or everyone.
settings.title: Heading of the plugin's settings.
settings.intro: Text under it when the plugin has settings.
settings.none: Text under it when the plugin has none.
egress.title: Heading of the hosts outside the workspace the plugin's service may reach.
egress.intro: Text under it when there are some. Socio is the product's name.
egress.intro-none: Text under it when there are none.
egress.pending: Note: the hosts listed come from settings saved but not yet given to the running service.
egress.from: After a host: the setting it came from. {{field}} is the setting's technical name.
egress.problem: A url setting that added no host. {{field}} is the setting's technical name; {{problem}} is why, from the server in English.
datasets.title: Heading of the workspace datasets the plugin uses.
datasets.intro: Text under it. A need is what the plugin's manifest asks a dataset for; unbound means no dataset is chosen for it.
budget.label: Label of the field: how many data operations the plugin may make each minute.
budget.use-default: Button that drops this plugin's own number, so it uses the workspace's.
budget.default: Under the field: the plugin uses the workspace's number, {{limit}}. Settings → General → Plugin datasets is where it is set; keep the page names as the Settings pages say them.
budget.override: Under the field: an admin set this plugin's own number. {{limit}} is the workspace's.
budget.counts: What counts as one operation. Socios are the product's AI agents.
budget.load-failed: Error toast when the plugin's data budget could not load.
budget.save-failed: Error toast when it could not be saved.
backup.last: End of the backup line: when the plugin was last backed up ({{when}}, a date and time); the size form adds how large it was.
backup.none-yet: End of the backup line when the plugin has never been backed up.
backup.ok: Backup line: all is well. {{volumes}} lists the plugin's storage volumes (technical names); {{last}} is the sentence about the last backup.
backup.stale: Backup line: the last good backup is old. {{volumes}} and {{last}} as above.
backup.failing: Backup line: the last backup failed. {{reason}} is why, from the server in English; the when form says when ({{when}}); {{last}} as above.
backup.no-reason: The reason when the server gave none.
backup.disabled: Backup line for a plugin an admin turned off; the since form says since when ({{when}}). {{last}} as above.
backup.first: Backup line for a plugin that declares backups but has none yet. Back up now is the button's name.
backup.undeclared: Backup line for a plugin whose installed version doesn't declare backups. service.backup is a manifest field; keep it. Update is the button's name.
backups.title: Heading of the plugin's backups.
backups.intro: Text under it. The data key is the workspace's encryption key.
backups.running: Before the backup line while a backup runs.
backups.now: Button that starts a backup now.
backups.load-failed: Error toast when the backups could not load.
backups.start-failed: Error toast when a backup could not start.
backups.empty: Shown when no backup is kept.
backups.entry: One kept backup, after its date: {{reason}} why it was taken, {{size}} its size, {{version}} the plugin's version then.
backups.noted: A backup's reason with the plugin's own note ({{note}}, the plugin's words).
backups.reasons.scheduled: Why a backup was taken: the workspace's schedule.
backups.reasons.manual: Why a backup was taken: an admin pressed Back up now (the button's name).
backups.reasons.request: Why a backup was taken: the plugin asked for one.
backups.reasons.pre-update: Why a backup was taken: before the plugin was updated.
backups.reasons.uninstall: Why a backup was taken: before the plugin was uninstalled.
danger.title: Heading of the section with Uninstall, kept apart because it can't be undone.
danger.uninstall-title: Title of the Uninstall row. {{name}} is the plugin's name.
danger.uninstall-bundled: What uninstalling does, for a plugin that runs inside Socio.
danger.uninstall-service: What uninstalling does, for a plugin that runs as its own service. Identity is its service account.
danger.uninstall: Button that opens the dialog that uninstalls the plugin.
danger.done: Toast after uninstalling. {{name}} is the plugin's name.
